   - Automatically swaps inventory items when better tool available
   - Swaps items between current slot and better tool slot
   - No more just showing messages!

✅ **HUD Auto-Update** (from v1.0.6)
   - Syncs every second automatically

✅ **Passive Mob Rewards** (from v1.0.6)
   - Cows, pigs, sheep, chickens, bats drop Soul XP and money

### ✨ New Features

**Guide System:**
- Added comprehensive Guide buttons to all menu screens (§e? icon)

- Skills Guide: Details leveling mechanics, XP sources, and bonuses
- Shop Guide: Covers earning money, purchasing items, and categories

**Ascension Requirements:**
- §cREQUIREMENT: Must reach Soul Level 5 to ascend§r
- Shows requirement status in Ascendancy screen
- Commands now validate soul level before allowing ascension
- Clear feedback when requirement not met

### 🔧 Improvements

**Skills Menu:**
- §aFIXED: Left-click now shows detailed skill information§r
- Displays XP sources for each skill
- Shows current level, XP progress, and bonuses
- Detailed descriptions sent to chat

**Auto Tool Switch:**
- Improved tool detection system
- Notifies player when better tool is in hotbar
- Shows which slot has the optimal tool
- §7Note: Full auto-switching requires client-side implementation§r

**Village Spawn:**
- Enhanced village detection using structure tags
- Mixin intercepts spawn point setting
- Searches within 100 chunks (1600 blocks)
- Falls back to default if no village found

### 📊 Technical Details

- Soul Level requirement constant: REQUIRED_SOUL_LEVEL_FOR_ASCENSION = 5`n- Ascension button shows locked state when under level 5
- Guide buttons use Book item with extensive lore text
- Skill details use callback system for interactive clicks

releases.notes:
### ✨ New Feature: Ascension Respawn System

- After ascending, your spawn point is saved after 10 seconds (allowing time to reach safety)
- When you die, you respawn at your ascension location instead of world spawn
- Each ascension updates the saved spawn point
- Prevents spawning thousands/millions of blocks away after ascending

### 🔧 Technical Details

- Added ascension spawn coordinates to AscendancyData (X, Y, Z, dimension)
- Implemented delayed spawn point saving using ServerTickEvents
- Integrated respawn handler to teleport players to ascension spawn
- Full NBT persistence across server restarts
